name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.05: Akai Me no Tora
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.05 アカイメノトラ
source:
Jake receives a job offer from an old female acquaintance, and is asked to investigate a robbery of an underground casino. Things start to get more complicated when a little girl suddenly shows up at the office, as the truth behind the case begins to unfold. 

[From [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#5]Pixelmenu[/url]]
translation:
一名过去相识的女性为神宫寺三郎带来工作，委托他调查地下赌场抢劫案。随着案件真相逐渐显露，一名小女孩又突然出现在事务所，事情开始变得愈发复杂。

[摘自[url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#5]Pixelmenu[/url]]
